organization_note: Aikido Security BV, registered in Belgium with its registered office in Ghent, is the contracting entity; its press kit says it was founded in Ghent and lists its European headquarters there, beside UK, APAC, and Defense headquarters elsewhere. Its principal business is a code, cloud, and runtime security platform, and Altar-1 is the model release the catalog reviews.
